description: Planted series with a legitimate lag column (LagTarget) and a same-period outcome leak (SamePeriodTarget).
sizingNote: 240 monthly periods (20 years; Ruling Q9: >= 240 months), monthly rather than daily because the planted seasonality is 12-month. Forecast scores use a rolling origin with K = 12 non-overlapping 12-month windows (144 scored forecasts, first origin after 96 training months), because a single 12-point test window measures RMSE with a relative SE of 0.248 while the 12 origins bring it to 0.071 (between-origin spread; evidence/logs/P2/recovery.txt). Paired naive-vs-oracle t = 5.46 over the 12 origins. The leak's noise SD (0.25) is a tenth of the AR error's stationary SD (2.5), so a model using SamePeriodTarget has near-zero error that no legitimate model can reach.
